conditions.why: Each generation must pass on gains (leave a 1) far faster than today; plausible only with sustained cheap energy and AI productivity.
Wars, pandemics and climate shocks keep recurring; cutting both their frequency and size for a century is historically rare.
Top-decile shares have been rising (e.g. Korea 46.1% in 2025); reversal needs political will against entrenched owners.
Energy cost declines are real (solar -90% since 2010); food, housing and care are harder, and gains may be captured by owners.
Unmeasurable: no index exists for genuine, uncoerced agreement, and the model has no consensus mechanism.

overall_judgment.note: Not a product of the rows above; conditions are correlated.

events_rough_order.event: Clean energy becomes the cheapest power almost everywhere
events_rough_order.why: Already true for most new projects per IRENA 2024 (verified); cheap energy lowers the cost of every basic need.

events_rough_order.event: No great-power war or nuclear use this century
events_rough_order.why: Guess. 12,241 warheads exist (SIPRI 2025, verified); one nuclear war is a huge setback s.

events_rough_order.event: Global pandemic preparedness (fast vaccines, early warning)
events_rough_order.why: Guess. COVID-19 showed vaccines can come within a year, but readiness is uneven.

events_rough_order.event: AI sharply cuts the cost of food, energy and housing construction
events_rough_order.why: Guess. Automation of farming and building is early; housing is limited by land and rules.
Guess. Emissions have not yet fallen globally; failure raises shock frequency.

events_rough_order.event: Open-source or public ownership of key AI and automation
events_rough_order.why: Guess. Decides whether near-free basics reach everyone or stay with owners.

events_rough_order.event: Universal basic floor (UBI or basic services) in major economies
events_rough_order.why: Guess. Only pilots so far; turns lower costs into guaranteed basics.

events_rough_order.event: Land/wealth taxes that cut top-decile wealth shares
events_rough_order.why: Guess. Few countries tax wealth; ties to "A Country of Kings".

events_rough_order.event: Education and honesty norms spread (Real Mode culture)
events_rough_order.why: Guess. Slow, generational; makes gains stick and lowers relapse.

verified_facts.fact: Utility-scale solar PV global weighted-average LCOE fell from USD 0.417/kWh (2010) to USD 0.043/kWh (2024), about -90%; battery storage fell 93% since 2010 to USD 192/kWh.
About 12,241 nuclear warheads existed in Jan 2025 (9,614 in military stockpiles, ~2,100 on high alert); SIPRI expects stockpiles may soon start growing again.
South Korea, end-March 2025: top 10% of households hold 46.1% of net assets, bottom 50% hold 9.1%; net-asset Gini 0.625.

real_world_tp_reason: All tp values are judgments; rates are guesses; the model has no consensus mechanism.
limitations: Levers map to r, p, s qualitatively; no fitted coefficients.
Event tps are not independent and must not be multiplied.
Freely chosen agreement cannot be measured or modeled here.
